title: Order and elements
legend: a_{ij} = element in row i, column j
back: A matrix of order $m\times n$ has $mn$ elements. 12 elements: 6 possible orders.

title: When is AB defined?
legend: n = columns of A = rows of B
back: Inner numbers match; outer numbers give the order. $AB$ may exist when $BA$ does not.

title: Entry of a product
back: Row $i$ of $A$ times column $j$ of $B$. In general $AB\ne BA$, and $AB=O$ does not mean $A=O$ or $B=O$.

title: Symmetric and skew-symmetric
back: Symmetric: mirror image in the diagonal. Skew-symmetric: every diagonal element is 0.

title: Any square matrix as a sum
back: Find $A'$, build both parts, show $P'=P$ and $Q'=-Q$, then verify $P+Q=A$.

title: Square of a sum
back: Equals $A^2+2AB+B^2$ only when $AB=BA$. The same care is needed for $(A+B)(A-B)$.

title: Inverse of a product
back: Reversal law again. $B$ is the inverse of $A$ when $AB=BA=I$; the inverse, if it exists, is unique.

title: A⁻¹ from a matrix equation
back: Multiply the equation by $A^{-1}$: $A-pI+qA^{-1}=O$. A favourite 3- and 5-mark ending.

title: Identity and scalar matrices
legend: I = identity: 1 on the diagonal, 0 elsewhere
back: Scalar matrix: $kI$. Diagonal matrix: zeros off the diagonal. $I^n=I$ for every $n$.
